title: DMSO and Compound Stock Solution Addition - Part 1
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Add DMSO to columns 2‑12
steps.instruction: Transfer 2.4 µL from the DMSO reservoir to columns 2 through 12 of Dilution Plates DMSO 1‑1 and DMSO 2‑1, keeping the tips after each transfer.

steps.title: Add DMSO to all wells of second plates
steps.instruction: Transfer 2.4 µL from the DMSO reservoir to every well of Dilution Plates DMSO 1‑2 and DMSO 2‑2, discarding the tips after each transfer.

steps.title: Add compound stock to dilution plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 7.2 µL from column 1 of the Compound Stock plate to column 1 of Dilution Plate DMSO 1‑1 (or to column 11 if the optional predilution step is used), keeping the tips.

steps.title: Serially transfer and mix within DMSO 1‑1
steps.instruction: Using the same tips, transfer 4.8 µL from column 1 of Dilution Plate DMSO 1‑1 to column 2 and mix; then repeat the transfer‑mix operation from column 2→3, 3→4, …, up to column 10→11 (skip column 12).

steps.title: Transfer DMSO from column 11 to DMSO 1‑2
steps.instruction: Transfer 4.8 µL from column 11 of Dilution Plate DMSO 1‑1 to column 1 of Dilution Plate DMSO 1‑2, mix, and keep the tips.

steps.title: Serially transfer and mix within DMSO 1‑2
steps.instruction: Using the same tips, transfer 4.8 µL from column 1 of Dilution Plate DMSO 1‑2 to column 2 and mix; then repeat the transfer‑mix operation from column 2→3, 3→4, …, up to column 10→11 (skip column 12), discarding the tips after the final transfer.

steps.title: Repeat dilution for column 2/12
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 3‑6 for column 2 (or column 12 if predilution is used) of the Compound Stock plate, applying the same sequence to Dilution Plates DMSO 2‑1 and DMSO 2‑2.

steps.title: Replace tip box
steps.instruction: Manually replace the tip box with a fresh one.

steps.title: Transfer DMSO to media plate 1‑1
steps.instruction: Transfer 2.4 µL from each column of Dilution Plate DMSO 1‑1 to the corresponding column of Media Plate 1‑1, discarding the tips after each transfer.

steps.title: Replace tip box again
steps.instruction: Manually replace the tip box with a fresh one.

steps.title: Repeat DMSO‑to‑media transfers
steps.instruction: Repeat the tip‑box replacement (step 8) and the DMSO‑to‑media transfer (step 9) for Dilution Plates DMSO 1‑2, DMSO 2‑1, and DMSO 2‑2 together with their corresponding Media Plates 1‑2, 2‑1, and 2‑2.
